ngautopilot-core.name: NgAutoPilot Core
ngautopilot-core.description: Routing, intake, compatibility, risk gates, and skill router — the minimum foundation every NgAutoPilot installation needs.
useCases: Bootstrap a new project on any agent

ngautopilot-angular.name: NgAutoPilot Angular
ngautopilot-angular.description: Full Angular catalog: components, signals, RxJS, router, forms, Material, SSR, testing, performance, security, AI/MCP — every Angular capability.
ngautopilot-angular.audience: Angular developers and teams building or maintaining Angular applications

ngautopilot-angular-upgrades.name: NgAutoPilot Angular Upgrades
ngautopilot-angular-upgrades.description: Major-by-major upgrade hops, version gates, changelog risk review, and upgrade-only satellites. Excludes modernization to keep upgrade work focused.

ngautopilot-angular-microfrontends.name: NgAutoPilot Angular Micro Frontends

ngautopilot-angular-microfrontends.audience: Teams building micro-frontend architectures with Angular

ngautopilot-frontend.name: NgAutoPilot Frontend
ngautopilot-frontend.description: Framework-agnostic frontend UX/UI/CX/WPO: accessibility, responsive CSS, design governance, product discovery, experience validation, web performance.
ngautopilot-frontend.audience: Frontend generalists working on Angular or any web framework

ngautopilot-quality.name: NgAutoPilot Quality
ngautopilot-quality.description: Quality and audit skills: ESLint, SonarQube, no-dead-code, technical debt triage, pull request review.

ngautopilot-typescript.name: NgAutoPilot TypeScript
